items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: We did -- then we did another show with Dennis O'Keefe called 'Never Sleep Over a Pretzel Factory' right after that

ctx.x: So Panama Francis was in that and this boy, Pretty Eddie, the drummer, he was Panama's understudy there. We did -- then we did another show with Dennis O'Keefe called 'Never Sleep Over a Pretzel Factory' right after that, then Max the Mirror or Max Cavulli had a place out in Brooklyn, and we used to play -- called Max the Mirror -- we used to play out there.

And then there was another job, Snaghead's Inn, and we -- I did some records with Dick Vance and Benny Morton on my own, you know, with the -- and then there was a play -- I was with a guy yesterday called Awfully Nice that I conducted. We went up to New Haven and up to Philly. It didn't go very far.
